name: Hawaii
overview: Hawaii DOH's Clean Air Branch requires an Air Pollution Control Permit before constructing, reconstructing, modifying, or operating a stationary air pollution source or control equipment, except as provided in HAR 11-60.1-62 and 11-60.1-82. Permits are either Covered Source Permits (major sources and sources subject to federal NSPS, NESHAP, or PSD; Hawaii's Title V-equivalent program) or Noncovered Source Permits (all other sources). Both have initial, renewal, temporary, general, modification, and transfer actions. Agricultural burning permits are also issued.

permitTypes.name: Permit exemptions
permitTypes.description: Exceptions to the permit requirement are in HAR 11-60.1-62 (noncovered) and 11-60.1-82 (covered).

permitTypes.name: General Permits (covered and noncovered)
permitTypes.description: General permits for numerous similar sources; covered general permits under HAR 11-60.1-92 and noncovered general permits under HAR 11-60.1-70.

permitTypes.name: Noncovered Source Permit
permitTypes.description: For stationary sources constructed, modified, or relocated after March 20, 1972 that are not covered sources. A noncovered source is a toxic source above set HAP levels. Temporary noncovered permits apply to portable sources.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DOH instructions: a noncovered source is a 'toxic source' if it emits or has potential to emit 2 tpy or more of any HAP, or 5 tpy or more of any combination.

permitTypes.name: Covered Source Permit (Title V program)
permitTypes.description: Covers major sources, sources subject to CAA Section 111 or 112 standards (excluding those subject only to 112(r)), and sources subject to PSD. Actions: initial, renewal, temporary, general, significant and minor modification, transfer.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DOH instructions: major source is 100 tpy or more of any air pollutant, or 10 tpy or more of any single HAP or 25 tpy or more of any combination of HAPs.

permitTypes.name: PSD
permitTypes.description: Sources subject to PSD are covered sources; PSD requirements are in HAR Chapter 11-60.1.

oilAndGas.summary: Hawaii has no oil and gas production. Refineries and fuel terminals are permitted as covered sources.
